name: Arms：Full firepower
detailed_description:
Immersive storyline experience
The plot design is gripping, with main quests spanning 3 to 10 hours and incorporating elements of suspense and thriller. The plot twists and turns are endless, immersing you throughout the entire journey and making you unable to stop.

Strategic Card Duel
Innovative card battle system, utilizing strategic card combinations to engage in turn based battles. Cleverly match the hero lineup, double the combat power, and enjoy the fun of intelligent combat.

Random Encounters on the Battlefield
The battlefield environment is unpredictable, with random encounters of lucky bosses, mysterious shops, surprise draws, and monsters of various levels. Route selection tests wisdom, while strategic layout determines victory or defeat.

Hero Recruitment Feast
Recruit heroes with unique characteristics, strengthen combat teams, and enrich tactical choices. Every hero is a unique presence on the battlefield, helping you tackle countless challenges.

The Path of Heroic Growth
Continuously enhance hero strength through upgrades, equipment enhancements, and other means. Make the hero stronger in battle and become your capable assistant in conquering the world.

Hero Team Art
Free combination of heroes to unleash team synergy. Different heroes complement each other's skills, jointly tackle various difficult challenges, and demonstrate team strength.

Hero Reshaping Plan
Reshaping dissatisfied heroes, retraining or acquiring valuable resources. Avoid wasting resources and keep your hero team in the best condition at all times.

Double cultivation secret realm
Join hands with female heroes to enter the secret realm of two person cultivation, enhance mutual understanding, and improve overall strength. There are also hidden contents waiting for you to unlock, opening a new adventure chapter.

Victory Glory Gift
After victory, generous rewards await you to claim. Help characters grow quickly, unlock more exciting gameplay, and allow you to freely explore the game world without obstacles.

Free Trade of Resources
Set up a free trading market within the game to buy and sell resources freely. Optimize resource allocation, easily obtain necessary items, and create personalized gaming experience.

【 dungeon exploration journey 】
As the game progresses, various dungeons are unlocked one by one. Experience different challenges and storylines, explore unknown new territories, and make your adventure journey full of infinite possibilities.

short_description: The apocalypse era. Non human invasion of the world. The man has been exhausted, and the last hope of humanity is to transform the girl into a weapon to defend the last territory. Can the weapon girls hold onto the last wasteland?
